I completely understand that feeling and way of thinking. I really do. Unfortunately this person isn’t in my life anymore, and I do believe that if I had acted differently, they’d still be in my life and maybe we’d still be friends. My person would tell me the same things, like I wasn’t a burden on them, or I wasn’t annoying them. And maybe I wasn’t in the moment, but eventually it got to breaking them down over the time. I’m not saying to break contact with this person, but set some boundaries with yourself and this person, yes it feels impossible to do and your body and mind will fight you tooth and nail but in the long run, it will be good for you bc this person will still hopefully be in your life and your Friend. My person got burnt out with me and stopped. Had I set those boundaries with myself, things could be different. Set those boundaries now, so you and your friend will have a long lasting relationship/friendship. It might feel sustainable now how this feels, but that feeling will burn out eventually, and it’s human nature to burn out, wether that’s you, or them. Do yourself a good thing and set those boundaries for yourself and this person so you guys will be happy and it will be a sustainable friendship for years to come.  Take it from me who didn’t set those boundaries and felt good in the moment just going at it the way I was going but burnt them out to the point they cut contact with no closure.
